_comment: Ledger of markdown citations that do not resolve to a tracked path, with the reason each one is
allowed to stay that way. Read by scripts/check-doc-citations.mjs; a citation that is neither
resolvable nor listed here fails the check.
Categories:
generated  the document is produced by the build and is gitignored, so a checkout never has it.
internal   the document exists in the maintainer working tree under a directory this public
repository excludes, so it will not arrive here.
lost       the document is not in the repository and not in any internal directory either.
external   the document belongs to a sibling repository or to the project vault, outside kuma.
prose      the string is not a citation at all; it is a filename mentioned in running text, a
usage placeholder, a test literal, or a fragment the extractor could not avoid.
A sixth category, stale, held four citations that named a page this repository does have at a
different path. Those citations were corrected rather than recorded, so the category is gone.
Prefer that outcome: a citation a reader can follow beats a well-worded excuse for one they
cannot. Add a category back only when a genuinely new kind of reason turns up.
Entries are exact reference strings, matched as written at the citation site. There is no prefix
or glob form on purpose: a rule such as "anything under the internal notes tree" would silently
admit every future unresolvable citation, which is the thing this check exists to stop.
The ledger has to shrink as well as grow, so an entry that no citation points at any more is a
failure, not a note. Drop it, or say in its reason why it is being held open.
